goal: Autonomous sprint sync via A2A open protocol

steps.description: Fetch upcoming sprint sync events and standup calendar entries using Google Calendar.
steps.reasoning: Identify scheduled sprint sync and standup events to extract meeting metadata and participant context.

steps.description: Query Jira for active sprint tasks, user stories, and bug reports to compile current sprint velocity and blocker statuses.

tool_args.jql: sprint in openSprints() AND status != Done

steps.reasoning: Gather real-time engineering metrics and task statuses directly from Jira to feed into the autonomous sprint sync report.

steps.description: Create a centralized Google Docs document for the Autonomous Sprint Sync summary and action matrix.

tool_args.title: Autonomous Sprint Sync Report - 2026-08-30
tool_args.content:
# Autonomous Sprint Sync Summary

## Calendar Context
- Pulled from calendar events: $step_1.events

## Active Engineering Tasks
- Total Open Issues: $step_2.total
- Blockers identified and escalated.

## Action Items
1. Review open Jira tickets.
2. Execute follow-up webhooks via A2A protocol.

steps.reasoning: Generate a rich, centralized artifact recording the sprint sync details for team collaboration.

steps.description: Dispatch the sprint sync summary report to the engineering team via Slack channel notification.

tool_args.message:
🚀 *Autonomous Sprint Sync Completed*

The automated sprint sync report has been successfully generated and documented.

📄 *Document Link*: $step_3.document_id
📊 *Active Sprint Issues*: Processed via Jira integration.

Please review the attached document and action items.

steps.reasoning: Notify the engineering team instantly on Slack with direct links to the generated sync document.

steps.description: Trigger an external A2A protocol webhook to notify external agent systems that the autonomous sprint sync workflow is successfully finalized.
steps.reasoning: Fulfill the A2A open protocol requirement by notifying external agent networks of the completed sync cycle.
